zh: Richard Austen Butler (1902-82) an English conservative politician who held every important position in government except that of prime minister. He is sometimes described as ‘the best prime minister we never had’. He was Chancellor of the Exchequer (1951-5), Home Secretary (1957-62), and Foreign Secretary (1963-4). （轮廓线、边缘或表面）粗糙的，参差不齐的，不规则的
en: old and torn
ex: a ragged jacket
一件破旧的夹克

zh: 衣衫褴褛的；破衣烂衫的
in a way that is not smooth or that lacks control
（轮廓线、边缘或表面）粗糙的，参差不齐的，不规则的
en: in old or torn clothes
ex: raggedly dressed
衣着破旧

zh: the fact of clothes being old and torn; the fact of wearing old and torn clothes
the fact of not being smooth, regular or well prepared
（轮廓线、边缘或表面）粗糙的，参差不齐的，不规则的
en: the fact of clothes being old and torn; the fact of wearing old and torn clothes
ex: the raggedness of her breathing
她呼吸的不规则

zh: old and torn; wearing old and torn clothes
having edges or ends that are not straight or even
en: old and torn; wearing old and torn clothes
ex: raggedy beggars
破烂的乞丐
